tabs.label: Document the way you practice
tabs.body: Heidi captures the encounter as it happens and writes notes that sound like you, not a generic template.

tabs.label: Structured, ready to review
tabs.body: Speech becomes organised documentation using clinician-designed templates or your own.

tabs.label: Nothing gets missed
tabs.body: Orders, follow-ups, and decisions are recognised as you speak, so tasks don’t rely on memory or manual tracking.

tabs.label: Fits your systems and standards
tabs.body: Notes align with regional clinical and billing requirements and flow back into your EMR, complete and structured.
